# Average mortgage broker salary in Australia
## What is the average mortgage broker’s salary in Australia?
As of 2026, the average annual salary of a mortgage broker in Australia is $100,000-$120,000 (SEEK). However, the salary does not take into account commissions.

Commissions are earned on top of the base salary and can range from $20,000-$100,000 per annum. Commissions are performance based and will vary depending on the experience of the broker, and the loans they’ve brokered for clients.

## Mortgage broker salary breakdown by experience
| Experience | Estimated base salary |
|-|-|
| Entry level (<1 year) | ~$50,000–$55,000 |
| Early career (1–4 years) | ~$60,000–$65,000 |
| Mid-career (5–9 years) | ~$66,000–$76,000 |
| Senior (10+ years) | ~$100,000+ |

## Average mortgage broker salary by state
| State | Base salary (2026, SEEK) | Upfront commission | Trail commission | Total commission |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| NSW/ACT | $110,000 | $113,376 | $72,750 | $186,126 |
| VIC | $105,000 | $108,901 | $70,521 | $179,422 |
| QLD | $102,000 | $110,545 | $75,901 | $186,446 |
| WA | $107,500 | $92,403 | $83,046 | $175,449 |
| SA | $96,000 | $103,113 | $70,630 | $173,743 |
| TAS | $85,000 | $89,859 | $54,652 | $144,511 |
| NT | $80,000 | $66,405 | $82,808 | $149,213 |

## How do mortgage brokers earn money?
### Upfront commissions
An upfront commission is paid as a percentage of the loan amount that is signed. According to the Mortgage and Finance Association of Australia (MFAA), upfront commission generally ranges from 0.65-0.70% of the loan. This means that if a mortgage broker’s client takes out a loan of $700,000, the upfront commission will be $4,900 at a rate of 0.7%.

## Recent updates to commissions for mortgage brokers
Changes implemented by NAB now allow the bank to only reclaim 6% of the commission if the home loan is closed after 2 years, down from the previous clawback percentage of 50%.

## Short answers to the most common questions
### How much do mortgage brokers earn per loan?
Upfront commission is usually 0.60% to 0.70% of the loan amount plus GST, paid once at settlement. Trail commission is usually 0.10% to 0.20% of the loan balance each year, paid only while the loan stays open. On a $700,000 loan that works out at roughly $4,200 to $4,900 upfront, then $700 to $1,400 a year.

## How Does a Mortgage Broker Get Paid in Australia?
### Upfront Commission
This commission is calculated based on the loan amount and typically ranges from 0.60% to 0.70% of the loan amount plus GST.

### Trail Commission
This commission is paid annually and typically ranges from 0.10% to 0.20% of the loan balance.
